_description: Itemized deduction parameters for Hawaii tax microsimulation
_source: IRS SOI 2022 Hawaii, reduced to match DOTAX actual patterns

itemization_rates._note: Probability of itemizing by AGI bracket. Reduced from raw SOI to match DOTAX actuals (was causing 333% overshoot).

avg_deductions._note: Average itemized deduction amount by AGI bracket. Reduced 40% from SOI to match DOTAX.

filing_status_multipliers._note: Multiplier applied to base itemization rate by filing status.

homeownership._note: Homeownership probability = base + (agi / income_scale) * slope, capped at cap.

mortgage_interest_tiers._note: Base mortgage interest deduction by AGI tier. Joint filers get 1.3x multiplier.

charitable_giving._note: Charitable giving as % of AGI by income tier. 72.7% of itemizers claim (SOI).

medical_expenses._note: Medical deduction claim rates and expense estimates by age group.

real_estate_taxes._note: Real estate tax deduction by AGI tier. 85.7% of itemizers claim (SOI, avg $3,638).
